SEARCH

All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AppSettings
Application-wide preferences for the FTP Client, persisted as JSON by ProfileStore.
ConnectionManager
The application controller: owns the persisted site profiles and settings, the single active RemoteClient session, and the TransferManager that runs the queue against it.
FtpClientMainPanel
The FTP Client's root panel: a toolbar and site selector along the top, a local browser and a remote browser side by side in the middle, and the transfer queue with a message log and status line at the bottom.
FtpRemoteClient
The FTP / FTPS RemoteClient, built on Apache Commons Net's FTPClient (plaintext) and FTPSClient (TLS).
ListParser
Parses raw FTP directory-listing lines into RemoteEntry values.
LocalBrowser
The left-hand pane of the client: a local-directory browser with a path bar and a table of files.
PasswordObfuscator
Reversible obfuscation for the optional saved site passwords.
ProfileStore
Persists the FTP Client's state as JSON under a configuration directory: the saved site profiles and the application settings.
ProfileStore.StoreException
Signals that persisted state could not be written.
ProgressListener
A low-level byte-progress callback for a single RemoteClient upload or download.
Protocol
The wire protocols the client can speak to a remote site.
RemoteBrowser
The right-hand pane of the client: the remote-directory browser.
RemoteClient
The protocol-neutral remote-file operations the session and UI layers use, so the same browser, transfer queue and resume logic work over FTP, FTPS and SFTP.
RemoteClientFactory
Builds the RemoteClient that matches a site's Protocol, so the session layer never has to know which transport library a given profile uses.
RemoteEntry
One entry in a remote directory listing: the protocol-neutral view the UI and the transfer logic work with, whether it came from an FTP LIST/MLSD or an SFTP ChannelSftp.ls.
RemotePaths
Pure helpers for the /-separated absolute paths both FTP and SFTP use, independent of the local platform's file separator.
SettingsDialog
A modal form for the application-wide AppSettings: timeouts, retry policy, buffer size, and the security-sensitive "allow saving passwords" switch (with an explicit warning that stored passwords are obfuscated, not encrypted).
SftpRemoteClient
The SFTP RemoteClient, built on JSch's ChannelSftp (the SSH File Transfer Protocol, which runs entirely over the encrypted SSH session).
SiteDialog
A modal form for creating or editing a SiteProfile: pick the protocol (FTP / FTPS / SFTP), host, port, credentials and options.
SiteProfile
A saved remote site: everything needed to reach one FTP / FTPS / SFTP server.
TransferJob
One queued file transfer: a direction (upload/download), the local and remote paths, and the live progress/state the transfer-queue table renders.
TransferJob.Direction
Which way the bytes move.
TransferJob.State
Lifecycle states, in the order a job normally moves through them.
TransferListener
Observes TransferJob lifecycle and progress events fired by the TransferManager.
TransferManager
Owns the transfer queue and the reliability policy around each job: retry with exponential backoff, resume from a partial destination, cooperative cancellation, and progress reporting to TransferListeners.
TransferMode
The FTP data-connection mode.
TransferTableModel
A read-only TableModel over the transfer queue.
